title: Saudi-led coalition says it destroyed two ballistic missiles aimed at Najran
detail: Coalition spokesman Turki Al-Maliki said two ballistic missiles aimed at Najran Province were intercepted; debris fell across the province and no casualties were reported at publication. No group had claimed the attack and the missile type was not identified. A civil-defense shelter alert was issued and later lifted. The report also lists earlier interceptions over Medina and the Eastern Province (Nov 5) and drones over Makkah (Nov 4, Nov 6). Single outlet report.

media.caption: Coalition intercepts two missiles over Najran
